cohort: The study cohort consisted of pregnant women diagnosed with aortic aneurysm whose files were reviewed at King Salman bin Abdulaziz Medical City.
finding: Only one patient with multiple aortic aneurysms was recorded during the 23-year study period, who was a primigravida with chronic hypertension and acute DVT, and was discharged with her baby in good condition after a LSCS.
mod_finding: The single recorded patient had a Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) and was discharged with her baby in good condition.
